# 1 Enoch Chapter 63 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**63:1** In-those-days shall-the-mighty and-the-kings who-possess-the-earth implore [Him] to-grant-them a-little-respite from-his-angels-of-punishment to-whom-they-were-delivered, that-they-might-fall-down and-worship before-the-Lord-of-Spirits, and-confess their-sins before-him.

**63:2** And-they-shall-bless and-glorify-the-Lord-of-Spirits, and-say: Blessed is-the-Lord-of-Spirits and-the-Lord-of-kings, and-the-Lord-of-the-mighty and-the-Lord-of-the-rich, and-the-Lord-of-glory and-the-Lord-of-wisdom.

**63:3** And-everything-that-is-secret is-manifest before-Thee, and-Thy-power is-for-all-generations, and-Thy-glory for-ever-and-ever: deep and-numberless and-without-investigation are-all-Thy-secrets, and-Thy-righteousness is-beyond-reckoning.

**63:4** We-have-now-learnt that-we-should-glorify and-bless the-Lord-of-kings and-Him-who-is-king over-all-kings.

**63:5** And-they-shall-say: Would-that-we-had-rest to-glorify and-give-thanks, and-confess-our-faith before-his-glory! And-now-we-long-for-a-little-rest but-find-it-not; we-follow-after and-obtain-it-not: and-light-has-vanished-from-before-us, and-darkness-is-our-dwelling-place for-ever-and-ever.

**63:6** For-we-have-not-believed before-him, nor-glorified the-name of-the-Lord-of-Spirits, but-our-hope-was-in-the-scepter-of-our-kingdom, and-in-our-glory.

**63:7** And-in-the-day of-our-suffering and-tribulation-he-saves-us-not, and-we-find no-respite for-confession that-our-Lord-is-true-in-all-his-works and-his-judgments and-his-justice, and-his-judgments-have-no-respect-of-persons.

**63:8** And-we-pass-away from-before-his-face on-account-of-our-works, and-all-our-sins-are-reckoned-up-in-righteousness.

**63:9** Now-they-shall-say unto-themselves: Our-souls-are-full-of-unrighteous-gain, but-it-does-not-prevent-us from-descending from-the-midst-thereof into-the-burden-of-Sheol.

**63:10** And-after-that their-faces-shall-be-filled-with-darkness and-shame before-that-Son-of-Man, and-they-shall-be-driven-from-his-presence, and-the-sword-shall-abide-before-his-face in-their-midst.

**63:11** Thus-spake-the-Lord-of-Spirits: This-is-the-ordinance and-judgment with-respect-to-the-mighty and-the-kings and-the-exalted and-those-who-possess-the-earth before-the-Lord-of-Spirits.

**63:12** And-other-forms I-saw-hidden-in-that-place: I-heard-the-voice-of-the-angel-saying: These are-the-angels who-descended-to-the-earth, and-revealed-what-was-hidden-to-the-children-of-men and-seduced the-children-of-men into-committing-sin.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Hyphenated compounds preserve Ge'ez construct chains. Ch. 63 is the prayer of the condemned kings — a futile confession that comes too late. The key verse is 63:6: 'our hope was in the scepter of our kingdom' — the ultimate indictment of earthly power. V. 12 introduces the fallen angels for the first time in the judgment context.*
